name: ES Closing Volume-Scar Escape v1
instrument: ES transaction-price and volume signal executed with one MES using recorded MBP-1 quotes
source: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ES trades and MES MBP-1
hypothesis: The price with the most transacted volume is a scar left by the closing auction's heaviest inventory negotiation. When both final price and final five-minute accepted value migrate to one side of that scar, the inventory handoff has escaped its gravity and should persist into the final half hour.

signal.volume_scar: transaction price with the greatest summed trade size over the observation window
signal.scar_tie_break: among tied prices choose the one closest to full-window transaction VWAP; if still tied choose the lower price
signal.confirmation_center: transaction-size-weighted mean price in the confirmation window
signal.long_signal: confirmation center and terminal price are both strictly above the volume scar
signal.short_signal: confirmation center and terminal price are both strictly below the volume scar
signal.zero_or_missing_rule: no trade if the two confirmations straddle or touch the scar, or a required value is missing

execution.entry_time: first MES MBP-1 record at or after 15:30:05 ET
execution.stop: none; one MES and a fixed approximately 29-minute holding period bound exposure
execution.exit_time: first recorded MES MBP-1 quote at or after 15:59:45 ET
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: the full recorded MES bid-ask spread is crossed at entry and exit; no additional modeled slippage

lesson: Escaping the same window's volume scar did not establish durable acceptance. Performance decayed across years and failed especially on longs.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: changing the observation or confirmation window
using a quantile, value area, bar VWAP, or a different scar tie-break
adding distance, volume, time, side, weekday, volatility, or regime filters
fading rather than following the confirmed escape
adding stops or changing execution times
